title: Kirszbraun extensions preserving uniform distance in Hilbert spaces
summary: Let $X$ be a subset of a real Hilbert space and let $v\colon X\to Y$, where $Y$ is a real Hilbert space. We prove that the following conditions are equivalent: whenever $A\subset X$, $ρ\geq0$, and $u\colon A\to Y$ is $1$-Lipschitz with $\left\lVert u(x)-v(x)\right\lVert\leqρ$ for $x\in A$, there is a $1$-Lipschitz extension $\widetilde u\colon X\to Y$ with $\left\lVert \widetilde u(x)-v(x)\right \lVert\leqρ$ for $x\in X$; and for every $1\leq k\leq\dim Y$, $$ \left\lVert v(x_0)-\sum_{i=1}^k t_i v(x_i)\right\lVert \leq \left\lVert x_0-\sum_{i=1}^k t_i x_i \right \lVert$$ whenever…
